text_block_list.text: I open the textbook. And just like the Champions Cup, the "Strongest Umamusume" also...
...Let's set it as having run the Chukyo 1800m.
choice_data_list: Apparently the hill right at the start is the key.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: A slope?
Chukyo 1800m starts halfway up a hill.
Because of that, it should be easier to run if she doesn't overdo the first stride, gradually setting her posture as she builds up speed.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: *slowly creeping in...*

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Tch, are you satisfied with this!?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I get it already!
...Haaaaahhhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Espo-san's training
seems kinda tough...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
She's a proven talent who won the Nambu Hai.
Of course her level would be high, right?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I know, but stiiill...
Eeeek...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my,
everyone else is looking up as well..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Espon really made a name for herself
all at once, didn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed...
As expected of Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...That's precisely why she's an opponent worth challenging.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, Tran-san.
Would you care to spar with me for one more round?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've got my own reasons
why I have to run, after all.

"—The day of the Champions Cup.
A day bringing together the titans of the dirt has begun."

I poured everything I possibly could
into preparing Espoir City for this day.

Her ability is second to none.
In this race too, she will surely—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Oh. If it ain't Acute.
You showed up here too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm here~.
Please keep me company.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wait, 'going out'...?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Stop spouting that wishy-washy crap and go hit 'em hard! Tell 'em you're gonna crush 'em, knock 'em flat!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
This place is
the "Champions Cup"!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(If I win this race!
If I win! I'll—!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well now, let me see~
This race is all about becoming a champion.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've come to challenge you too.
Getting fired up with an 'alley-oop!'

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My fighting spirit is bubbling over!
Let me give it all I've got, okay~?
